notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics & in-app guidance) evaluating Redwood for chat-based agent to replace parts of current bot infra. Primary focus: Hosted API for quick POC, then potential move to Dedicated for predictable latency and capacity. Key ask is regional latency (NA + EU) and smart routing/fallbacks for uptime during regional maintenance.

Contact behavior: CTO (Rhea Patel) and Head of Product (Marcus Li) highly technical — want latency numbers and streaming demo. AE (Alicia) did intro call 2026-01-18; SE (Diego) demo 2026-02-18. Marcus: "We need sub-300ms p95 in EU for interactive agent flows; streaming must start sending tokens within 80ms for perceived responsiveness."

POC plan: 2-week Hosted API POC using sample chat flows + tool-calling (calendar, ticket lookup). Measure p50/p95 across regions, validate streaming token latency, validate function-call determinism. Provide synthetic traffic to simulate 3–5 concurrent user sessions per seat (peak sim).

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, EU data residency is a showstopper for EU customers. They asked about KMS integration and audit logs retention (90d+). Legal has open questions about data processing agreements; security questionnaire uploaded to Drive.

Commercial: Pricing sensitivity moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics meet targets. Want a pricing construct that allows Hosted API for dev + warm-up and Dedicated for production per-region. Interested in reserved capacity + burst window.

Quotes / direct notes from call: "If the fallback model returns answers that materially change UX, product team won't accept it — need graceful degradation, not noisy hallucinations."

Next meetings: 2026-03-07 full-team POC kickoff; 2026-03-21 interim check (metrics review).

Internal notes: SE to provision Hosted API keys scoped for POC, enable streaming examples and function-call stubs; run A/B test of routing (NA primary, EU primary) and record failover behavior. AE to prepare Dedicated pricing scenarios (monthly and annual commit).
